data.name: GLP_1 RA stable dose
data.text: Participants taking GLP_1 RAs, GLP_1/GIP RAs, GLP_1/Gcg RAs, GLP_1/GIP/Gcg RAs, or similar medications for approved indications will be permitted to enroll provided they are on a stable dose at the time of screening (no anticipated dose escalations).

data.name: Renal impairment exclusion
data.text: Have an eGFR <90 mL/min/1.73 m2 determined by the central laboratory during screening (Visit 1).

data.name: Hepatic disease or impairment exclusion
data.text: Have a hepatic disease or hepatic impairment, defined as any of the following: cirrhosis, primary biliary cholangitis, viral hepatitis, autoimmune hepatitis, or signs or symptoms of any other liver disease (exception: metabolic dysfunction_associated steatotic liver disease [MASLD]); any degree of hepatic impairment as defined by the Child_Pugh classification (Child_Pugh A, B, or C), regardless of etiology.

data.name: Osteoporosis or vitamin D deficiency exclusion
data.text: Have a history of osteoporosis, osteomalacia, or presence of untreated severe vitamin D deficiency (serum 25_hydroxy_vitamin D ≤5 ng/mL).

data.name: Fracture or bone surgery exclusion
data.text: Have a history of fracture, bone surgery (for example, hardware placement, join replacement, bone grafting, or amputation), or clinically significant bone trauma within 8 weeks of screening.

data.name: Addison disease exclusion
data.text: Have a history of Addison disease.

data.name: Paget's disease exclusion
data.text: Have a history of Paget's disease of the bone.

data.name: Other bone disease exclusion
data.text: Have a history of any other bone disease that effects bone metabolism (for example, osteopetrosis or osteogenesis imperfecta).

data.name: Recent cardiovascular event exclusion
data.text: Have had within the past 180 days before screening: acute myocardial infarction; cerebrovascular accident (stroke); hospitalization for unstable angina; hospitalization due to congestive heart failure; or coronary revascularization.

data.name: Chronic neutropenia exclusion
data.text: Have a history of chronic neutropenia.

data.name: CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers exclusion
data.text: Have been treated with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of moderate and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers.

data.name: CYP3A4 narrow therapeutic index substrates exclusion
data.text: Have been treated with CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index within 14 days or 5 half_lives (whichever is longer) prior to randomization, or plan to receive treatment with these CYP3A4 modulators during the study. See Section 10.14 for a list of CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index.

data.name: Bone active treatments exclusion
data.text: Have received any of the following bone active treatments within the time frames specified below, or plan to receive them during the study: oral bisphosphonate use (>3 months cumulative treatment in the past 2 years, OR >1 month in the past year, OR any use during the 3 months prior to screening); administration of intravenous zoledronic acid within the last 5 years; administration of intravenous bisphosphonate (excluding zoledronic acid), fluoride, or strontium within the past 2 years; parathyroid hormone (PTH), or PTH derivative (teriparatide, abaloparatide) in the past year; or treatment with denosumab in the past year.

data.name: Treatments within 3 months of screening exclusion
data.text: Administration of any of the following treatments within 3 months of screening.

data.name: Screening to Study Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following screening (Visit 1, up to Day _42) including endoscopy with biopsy performed within 21 days before randomization, eligible participants are registered with IWRS and randomized/assigned to an ISA and to study intervention at Visit 2 (Week 0, baseline/randomization).

data.name: Study Period 1 to Study Period 2 Transition
data.text: At Week 12 (Visit 6, ±7 days) the endoscopy must be performed sufficiently early within the visit window so that results confirm the participant's response status before starting Study Period 2.

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation of LY4395089 for Nontraumatic Fracture
data.text: A participant treated with LY4395089/mirikizumab co_administration in this ISA must be permanently discontinued from LY4395089 for occurrence of nontraumatic bone fracture confirmed by imaging and clinical evaluation.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of LY4395089 for Suspected Fracture
data.text: LY4395089 must be interrupted if a nontraumatic fracture is suspected (e.g., new unexplained localized bone pain, swelling, tenderness, reduced mobility, pain during normal daily activities, visible deformity, or signs of vertebral compression such as sudden back pain or height loss) to ensure appropriate evaluation and management.

data.description: Completion of all protocol_required visits and assessments; LY4395089 and mirikizumab will not be provided to participants after completion of the study.

data.name: ISA and Treatment Assignment Decision at Randomization
data.description: At Visit 2 (Week 0), participants are registered with IWRS, assigned to an ISA (randomly if eligible for more than 1 open ISA), and randomized to study intervention.

data.name: Week 12 Endoscopic Response Assessment Decision
data.description: Primary endpoint timepoint; endoscopy results must confirm response status before the participant may start Study Period 2.

data.name: Screening Endoscopy Adequacy Decision
data.description: Decision to repeat endoscopy during screening if inadequate bowel preparation or equipment issues occurred.

data.name: Suspected Fracture Evaluation Decision
data.description: If a nontraumatic fracture is suspected, LY4395089 is interrupted pending evaluation; if confirmed by imaging and clinical evaluation, LY4395089 is permanently discontinued.

data.name: BMD Threshold Notification Decision
data.description: Central reader analysis of DXA scans; sites informed if T_score < _2.5 or Z_score < _2.0.

data.name: Compliance Assessment Decision
data.description: At each visit, compliance is assessed by direct questioning, counting returned unused study intervention/empty bottles or cartons, and review of the mirikizumab SC dosing diary; poorly compliant participants receive additional training and instruction.

data.name: Conditional Baseline Sample Collection Decision
data.description: At Visit 2, stool supernatant is collected only if not collected before Visit 2; genetics sample obtained at or after Visit 2 if country regulations allow.
